mostWorthwhile.text: Joining the chest and lower body was most worthwhile: the diaphragm and separate routes helped me picture how the regions connect.

leastWorthwhile.text: Attaching the second arm was straightforward but less interesting; its opposite-shoulder placement was predictable.

surprise.text: The lymph connection lined up with the existing neck-vein junction rather than making a second one. That helped me see it as the same route.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt particularly arbitrary. The named slots and goals explained the fittings, though most choices were straightforward.

continue.text: I would probably continue if another chapter explored how the assembled systems work together. Putting them together was satisfying, although the final fittings were mostly predictable.
